intro.title: Work: the job, the people, the week
intro.body:
Thirty-six words in three layers: getting the job, the people and the money once you have it, and the week you actually work.
The picture is only a hint — the Czech under it is the meaning.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: permanent and full-time answer different questions. permanent / temporary is how long the contract lasts; full-time / part-time is how many hours you work. A job can be permanent and part-time at the same time.

sentences.en: Our company has a vacancy for a teacher who can start in September.
sentences.cz: Naše firma má volné místo pro učitele, který může nastoupit v září.
accepts: Our company has a vacancy for a teacher who can start in September

sentences.en: The candidate we met yesterday has the right qualification, but she lives in Ostrava.
sentences.cz: Uchazečka, kterou jsme včera potkali, má správnou kvalifikaci, ale bydlí v Ostravě.
accepts: The candidate we met yesterday has the right qualification, but she lives in Ostrava

sentences.en: I need a reference from my old school before I can apply.
sentences.cz: Než se můžu přihlásit, potřebuji doporučení ze své staré školy.
accepts: I need a reference from my old school before I can apply

sentences.en: The company wants to hire two new people because the office needs more teachers.
sentences.cz: Ta firma chce přijmout dva nové lidi, protože kancelář potřebuje víc učitelů.
accepts: The company wants to hire two new people because the office needs more teachers

sentences.en: This job is permanent, not temporary, so I can plan the next few years.
sentences.cz: Tahle práce je stálá, ne dočasná, takže si můžu naplánovat několik dalších let.
accepts: This job is permanent, not temporary, so I can plan the next few years

sentences.en: My sister works part-time because she studies at the university.
sentences.cz: Moje sestra pracuje na částečný úvazek, protože studuje na univerzitě.
accepts: My sister works part-time because she studies at the university
My sister works part time because she studies at the university

sentences.en: My supervisor gives me good feedback when I finish a difficult job.
sentences.cz: Můj nadřízený mi dává dobrou zpětnou vazbu, když dokončím těžkou práci.
accepts: My supervisor gives me good feedback when I finish a difficult job

sentences.en: Our new client is from Prague, but the meetings are always online.
sentences.cz: Náš nový klient je z Prahy, ale schůzky jsou vždycky online.
accepts: Our new client is from Prague, but the meetings are always online

sentences.en: My brother got a promotion after he worked here for five years.
sentences.cz: Můj bratr dostal povýšení poté, co tu pět let pracoval.
accepts: My brother got a promotion after he worked here for five years

sentences.en: Her income is lower than her sister's, but she has more free time.
sentences.cz: Její příjem je nižší než sestřin, ale má víc volného času.
accepts: Her income is lower than her sister's, but she has more free time

sentences.en: My father will retire next year, but he still wants to teach on Fridays.
sentences.cz: Otec příští rok odejde do důchodu, ale pořád chce v pátek učit.
accepts: My father will retire next year, but he still wants to teach on Fridays

sentences.en: My uncle is self-employed, so he works longer hours than we do.
sentences.cz: Můj strýc je OSVČ, takže pracuje déle než my.
accepts: My uncle is self-employed, so he works longer hours than we do
My uncle is self employed, so he works longer hours than we do

sentences.en: I commute to work by train because the parking in the city is expensive.
sentences.cz: Do práce dojíždím vlakem, protože parkování ve městě je drahé.
accepts: I commute to work by train because the parking in the city is expensive

sentences.en: My deadline is on Friday, but I have not started the report.
sentences.cz: Uzávěrku mám v pátek, ale ještě jsem tu zprávu nezačal.
accepts: My deadline is on Friday, but I have not started the report
My deadline is on Friday, but I haven't started the report

sentences.en: I have the night shift this week, so I sleep when the children are at school.
sentences.cz: Tento týden mám noční směnu, takže spím, když jsou děti ve škole.
accepts: I have the night shift this week, so I sleep when the children are at school

sentences.en: We need to postpone the meeting because the boss is ill.
sentences.cz: Musíme tu schůzku odložit, protože je šéf nemocný.
accepts: We need to postpone the meeting because the boss is ill

sentences.en: My workload is bigger this month than it was in the summer.
sentences.cz: Mám tento měsíc větší vytížení než v létě.
accepts: My workload is bigger this month than it was in the summer

sentences.en: This task is my responsibility, but my colleague helped me finish it.
sentences.cz: Tenhle úkol je moje zodpovědnost, ale kolega mi ho pomohl dokončit.
accepts: This task is my responsibility, but my colleague helped me finish it
